title: Shark, Makeup by Mario and Dcypher crowned Pure Beauty Awards 2026 winners
summary: Dcypher, Jo Malone London, Sculpted by Aimee, Makeup by Mario and Shark are among the beauty brands crowned the best in the business across 21 categories at the Pure Beauty Awards 2026, which took place at London’s Grosvenor House in the UK

extraction.key_fact: 여러 뷰티 브랜드들이 영국 런던에서 열린 뷰티 시상식에서 수상자로 선정되었다.
